text:
Maria Chen: Quick async check — I'd like to enable `dynamic_throttle_v2` for a tiny canary on Dedicated pools (region=us-west1). Scope: internal traffic + partner-alpha only, start at 2% by IP-hash. Can we confirm the guardrails: max_concurrency soft-cap = 80, queue_length hard limit = 1000, auto-fallback to `static_throttle` if p50 latency > 250ms? Also want memory pressure kill (>=85%). Who can sign off on the rollout command and monitoring window?

Ash Patel: LGTM from infra side. PR #4821 wires the flag. Planned rollout command (test in staging first):
```
rfg set-flag dynamic_throttle_v2 --on --audience "internal,partner-alpha" --percent 2 --scope "dedicated:us-west1"
```
I'll run staging smoke then prod canary once Priya/Jorge give thumbs.

Priya Rao: Adding the memory pressure gating now — I'll gate at 85% resident mem for the pool and a small circuit that disables automatically. Snippet I added to the gating rules: 
```
# pseudo-config
if mem_percent(pool) > 85:
  disable_flag("dynamic_throttle_v2")
```
Also added a soft rollback if error_rate increases by 2x in 5m.

Jorge Alvarez: Oncall note — please prime the emergency kill switch `redwood.safe_mode` and schedule a 30m watch starting at rollout time (suggest 10:00 PDT). If latency or error budget breaches, we flip to safe_mode and rollback. Need a Datadog dashboard link in the rollout description.

Linh Tran: Useful metric queries to keep an eye on during the canary: 
- `avg(last_5m, latency.p50{service:inference,region:us-west1})`
- `sum(last_1m, queue_length{pool:dedicated,region:us-west1})`
- `avg(last_5m, mem_percent{pool:dedicated})`
Add alert: `queue_length > 500` for 2m -> page oncall. Also monitor traffic skew by customer (internal vs external).

deploy-bot: Rollout plan created: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/rollout-1911122334 — canary 2% for 30m -> increase to 10% for 30m if no alerts. Auto-rollback on any SLO breach.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z — 30m watch window.

Ash Patel: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821 — tagging @Priya Rao for final CR and @Jorge Alvarez for oncall ack.

Priya Rao: Reviewing now, will leave comments by EOD. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Thanks — if Priya + Jorge give green I'll coordinate the staging run and then the prod canary. :thumbsup:
